name: Hôtel Ritz Paris
description: Hôtel Ritz Paris, located in Place Vendôme, is a historic luxury hotel renowned for its opulent Belle Époque interiors and association with iconic figures like Coco Chanel and Ernest Hemingway. It features Michelin-starred dining at the restaurant L’Espadon and a renowned spa, blending timeless elegance with modern luxury.

name: Four Seasons Hotel George V, Paris
description: Four Seasons Hotel George V, Paris is a luxury hotel renowned for its Art Deco design, exceptional service, and three Michelin-starred restaurants, including Le Cinq. Located just steps from the Champs-Élysées, it features lavish rooms, a spa, and stunning floral arrangements by Jeff Leatham.

name: Hôtel de Crillon, A Rosewood Hotel
description: Hôtel de Crillon, A Rosewood Hotel, is a historic luxury hotel located on Place de la Concorde in Paris, renowned for its opulent 18th-century architecture and lavish interiors. It features Michelin-starred dining by chef Christopher Hache and offers exclusive suites with views of the Eiffel Tower and the Tuileries Garden. The hotel blends Parisian heritage with contemporary elegance, making it a landmark of refined hospitality.

name: Le Bristol Paris
description: Le Bristol Paris is a historic luxury hotel located on Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré, renowned for its elegant 18th-century Parisian decor, a three-Michelin-starred restaurant (Epicure), and a lush rooftop garden with views of the Eiffel Tower. It is celebrated for exceptional French haute cuisine and impeccable personalized service.

name: Shangri‑La Paris
description: Shangri-La Paris is a luxury palace hotel housed in a former royal residence, blending French classical architecture with Asian-inspired decor. It features Michelin-starred dining by chef Christophe Moret, including the renowned Shang Palace specializing in Cantonese cuisine. The hotel offers panoramic views of the Eiffel Tower and the Seine River.
